AISA Chief Demands Amit Shah's Resignation, NEP Rollback

AISA national president Neha Bora has stated that the protest demanding the resignation of Union Home Minister Amit Shah will continue. Bora also called for a complete rollback of the National Education Policy (NEP). The coverage indicates these demands are central to the group's ongoing activities.
